articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Canal Park Food Pantry
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the edit0r: I have lived on Fairview Road for 40 years, and I want to say what a difference the Canal Park Food Pantry has made.
Please keep the bus shelter in the budget. Many of us on Fairview Road use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Bernadette Reyes, Cedar Hollow
